be licensed to sell alcohol: Only stores that are licensed to sell alcohol may offer beer and wine to adult customers.
只有獲准售酒的商店才可以販賣啤酒和葡萄酒給成年顧客。
license a product: The toy company paid a lot of money to license a product based on the popular cartoon.
那家玩具公司花了很多錢，取得以那部熱門卡通為主題的授權產品。
license to kill: In many spy movies, the hero carries a license to kill and travels around the world.
在許多間諜電影裡，主角持有殺人執照並環遊世界。
under license: These sneakers are made under license by a factory in Vietnam, not by the famous brand itself.
這些球鞋是越南一家工廠獲授權生產的，並非那個知名品牌自己製造。
lift a ban: The city government finally agreed to lift a ban on street performers in the main park.
市政府終於同意解除主要公園裡街頭藝人的禁令。
lift one's spirits: A warm cup of tea and a funny movie always lift my spirits after a long, tiring day.
漫長疲憊的一天後，一杯熱茶和一部好笑的電影總能振奮我的精神。
lift sanctions: The two countries signed a peace deal, so the United Nations agreed to lift sanctions on trade.
兩國簽署了和平協議，因此聯合國同意解除貿易制裁。
lift restrictions: Once the number of cases dropped, the government began to lift restrictions on travel and large events.
一旦病例數下降，政府就開始解除對旅遊和大型活動的限制。
give someone a lift: It was raining hard, so my neighbor offered to give me a lift to the train station.
雨下得很大，所以我的鄰居主動提議載我一程到火車站。
lift weights: My brother goes to the gym three times a week to lift weights and build stronger muscles.
我哥哥每週去健身房三次舉重，鍛鍊更強壯的肌肉。
the fog lifted: We could finally see the beautiful mountains around the lake once the fog lifted in the late morning.
接近中午霧散了之後，我們終於能看見湖邊美麗的群山。
light up one's face: Good news from her family can always light up her face, even on her most tiring days.
即使在她最疲累的日子，家人傳來的好消息總能使她臉上發光。
light up a room: Grandma has such a warm and cheerful personality that she can light up a room just by walking in.
奶奶的個性溫暖又開朗，光是走進來就能讓整個房間亮起來。
light a fire: When we went camping, my dad taught us how to light a fire using only dry leaves and small sticks.
我們去露營時，爸爸教我們只用乾樹葉和小樹枝來生火。
come to light: Several years later, the truth about the missing painting finally came to light when a letter was found.
幾年後，一封信被找到，那幅失蹤畫作的真相終於曝光。
light on an idea: We were about to give up when Amy happened to light on an idea for our science fair project by chance.
我們正要放棄時，艾咪偶然想到了科展專題的點子。
make light of: You should never make light of a friend's problems, even if they seem small to you.
即使朋友的問題在你看來很小，你也絕不該輕描淡寫。
limit the damage: After the oil spill, workers rushed to the coast to limit the damage to the beaches and sea birds.
漏油事件發生後，工人們趕往海岸控制對海灘和海鳥造成的損害。
limit spending: To save money for a trip to Japan, I decided to limit spending on snacks and online shopping.
為了存錢去日本旅行，我決定限制在零食和網購上的開支。
limit oneself to: To stay healthy, my mother tries to limit herself to one cup of coffee a day.
為了保持健康，我媽媽盡量一天只限於喝一杯咖啡。
limit access: The school decided to limit access to the science lab so that students cannot enter without a teacher.
學校決定限制實驗室的存取，讓學生沒有老師陪同就不能進入。
know one's limits: A good climber knows his limits and turns back when the weather becomes too dangerous.
好的登山者知道自己的極限，天氣變得太危險時就會折返。
line one's pockets: The dishonest official used public money to line his pockets instead of building new roads.
那名不誠實的官員用公款中飽私囊，而不是去修建新道路。
line up for tickets: Hundreds of fans started to line up for tickets outside the stadium before the sun came up.
數百名歌迷在太陽升起前就開始在體育館外排隊買票。
line the streets: Thousands of cheering fans will line the streets to welcome the baseball team home after their big win.
數千名歡呼的球迷將沿街排列，歡迎大勝的棒球隊回家。
line up support: Before the election, the candidate worked hard to line up support from teachers and local business owners.
選舉前，那位候選人努力爭取老師和在地商家的支持。
in line with: The new school rules are in line with what most students and parents asked for in the survey.
新的校規與大多數學生和家長在問卷中提出的要求一致。
toe the line: Employees who refuse to toe the line may lose their chance of getting a promotion at this company.
在這家公司，拒絕服從的員工可能會失去升遷的機會。
